width.$description: Stroke widths. Borders are always drawn as a stroke with a color-border-* token, never with shadows.

none.$description: No stroke. Borderless variants (text button, filled field without outline).

default.$description: 1px. Default border: cards, inputs, dividers, outlined buttons.

strong.$description: 2px. Selected or active outlines, emphasis rings (badge ring).

focus.$description: 2px. Focus ring thickness (WCAG 2.4.13 recommends at least 2px). Use with color-border-focus.

offset.$description: 2px. Gap between a control and its focus ring.
